en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large open square used as a hay market, bordered by trees and a low fence in the foreground and multi‑storey buildings in the background. Numerous carts loaded with hay and people are visible across the square. Printed captions in German identify the scene as a hay market near a city gate. There is cursive handwriting across the bottom margin.
